title: A validated Rhodamine B fluorescence quenching spectrofluorimetric method for solriamfetol determination in human plasma with pharmacokinetic application
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27021-27034
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02388F, Paper
Open Access

Ahmed Serag, Razaz Abdulaziz Felemban, Abdulaziz H. Al Khzem, Mansour S. Alturki, Mohammed F. Aldawsari, Manal E. Alosaimi, Maram H. Abduljabbar, Atiah H. Almalki
A novel spectrofluorimetric method was developed for solriamfetol based on static quenching of Rhodamine B. The method was successfully optimized, validated and applied for pharmacokinetic analysis of solriamfetol in clinical samples.
